model.flight_analytics.int_flight_boardi.name: int_flight_boarding
model.flight_analytics.int_flight_boardi.description: Intermediate model joining flights with boarding pass details
model.flight_analytics.int_flight_boardi.compiled_code:
with flights as (

    select * from FLIGHT_ANALYTICS.staging.stg_flights

),

boarding_passes as (

    select * from FLIGHT_ANALYTICS.staging.stg_boarding_passes

),

flight_boarding_details as (

    select
        f.flight_id,
        f.route_no,
        f.status as flight_status,
        f.scheduled_departure,
        f.scheduled_arrival,
        f.actual_departure,
        f.actual_arrival,
        bp.ticket_no,
        bp.seat_no,
        bp.boarding_no,
        bp.boarding_time,
        
    case
        when actual_departure is null or actual_arrival is null then null
        when datediff('second', actual_departure, actual_arrival) / 3600 <= 1 then 'short flight'
        when datediff('second', actual_departure, actual_arrival) / 3600 <= 5 then 'average flight'
        else 'long flight'
    end
 as flight_distance_type
    from flights f
    left join boarding_passes bp on f.flight_id = bp.flight_id

)

select * from flight_boarding_details

model.flight_analytics.int_bookings_dist.name: int_bookings_distribution
model.flight_analytics.int_bookings_dist.description: Hourly distribution of booking volume and revenue
model.flight_analytics.int_bookings_dist.compiled_code:
with bookings as (

    select * from FLIGHT_ANALYTICS.staging.stg_bookings

),

bookings_distribution as (

    select
        extract(hour from book_date) as booking_hour,
        count(*) as booking_count,
        sum(total_amount) as total_revenue,
        avg(total_amount) as avg_booking_amount
    from bookings
    group by extract(hour from book_date)
    order by booking_hour

)

select * from bookings_distribution

model.flight_analytics.int_ticket_snapsh.name: int_ticket_snapshot
model.flight_analytics.int_ticket_snapsh.description: Daily ticket snapshot that accumulates ticket data for each processing_date (incremental append)
model.flight_analytics.int_ticket_snapsh.compiled_code:
with snapshot as (

    select
        t.ticket_no,
        b.book_ref,
        t.passenger_id,
        t.passenger_name,
        t.outbound,
        b.book_date,
        b.total_amount,
        case when t.ticket_no is null then true else false end as is_orphan_booking,
        '2025-10-02'::date as snapshot_date,
        '2593b5f1-252a-4cc2-97fd-52bc3e4dcdd3' as _run_id,
        current_timestamp() as _loaded_at
    from FLIGHT_ANALYTICS.staging.stg_bookings b
    left join FLIGHT_ANALYTICS.staging.stg_tickets t 
        on t.book_ref = b.book_ref
    where date(b.book_date) = '2025-10-02'::date

)

select * from snapshot
